title: Prime chains in a filtered ring colimit occur at one stage
statement: Let S be a filtered colimit of rings R_i. Every finite strictly increasing chain of prime ideals in S contracts, for some sufficiently large index i, to a strictly increasing chain of prime ideals in R_i. Consequently dim S <= sup_i dim R_i, for Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
